minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  2nd Floor Council Chamber
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Strategic Planning/Southeast Taskforce/Committee Meeting

  HIGHLIGHTS

  Monday, October 14, 2019
  5:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time  October 14, 2019 / 5:00pm

IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor John A. Mirisch, City Manager George Chavez, Director of
  Community Development Susan Healy Keene, Assistant Director of
  Community Development Ryan Gohlich, Julian Javor (Recreation &
  Parks Commission), Senior Planner Timmi Tway, Marketing and
  Economic Sustainability Manager Laura Biery, Adonis Angelo
  Antonio Simmons (Next Beverly Hills), John DeLuca (Resident),
  Jim Garrett (Resident), Rabbi David Baron (Saban Theatre), Isaac
  Gabai, Susan Mishler, Linda Brown, Ed Brown, Abraham Assil,
  Amir Dar.

  1)  Public Comment
  1. None.

  2) Welcome and Introduction
   Brief introduction from committee attendees
   Brief overview of the last meeting: pedestrian amenities

  3) Discussion of Urban Design in the Southeast Area of Beverly Hills
   Presentation by City staff
   Discussion regarding pedestrian amenities focusing aesthetics,
  architecture, commercial signage, how buildings interact with the street,
  wayfinding and monuments, and green and open spaces.

  4) Activity and Feedback
   City staff asked for input from those in attendance about geographic areas
  that have the most room for improvement and any other ideas for
  exploration.
   Staff collected feedback.

  5) Adjournment
   The next meeting of the Strategic Planning Committee/Southeast Task
  Force is scheduled for November 4, 2019.
 Adjourn
 Date / Time  October 14, 2019 / 6:00pm
